sources.title: darioooooo0o/Spark-X2.5-4B-GGUF · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Community GGUF quantizations of XHToken/Spark-X2.5-4B, a 4.1B hybrid-attention (3:1 sliding-window:full) model with native 1M context. Quantized with an importance matrix calibrated on multilingual text, targeting fully GPU-resident inference on 4/8/12/16GB cards with at least 64K context (128K preferred).
